info.name: TruckTrack API
info.description:
Complete API documentation for TruckTrack Fleet Management System.

## Authentication
Most endpoints require a Bearer token. Get your token from the Login endpoint and add it to the Authorization header.

## Roles
- **ADMIN**: Full access to all endpoints
- **DRIVER**: Limited access to own trips and profile

## Base URL
`http://localhost:5000/api`
